pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against averaging down or pyramiding into falling knives; subsequent positions only authorized if existing trades are structurally profitable and trailing stops lock in net-positive breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry authorized within 15 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic tier-1 releases, requiring a validated 5-period EMA cross and volume-weighted momentum confirmation.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively secure floating gains via trailing activation once the asset moves +$10.00 in favor, scaling out tranches to force $15-$30+ outlier wins.
